proposals: The Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas should publish and update a state-by-state register of every levy on fuel ethanol — licence, renewal, capacity, supervision, transport-pass and regulatory fees, in rupees per bulk litre — so that the cost the Lalta Prasad Vaish ruling opened up is tracked across states rather than discovered one Punjab-style policy at a time.

Every state excise department should publish its full fee and duty schedule for potable and industrial alcohol as a machine-readable file on its own website, matching what Rajasthan already does, so that levies in states such as Uttar Pradesh, Haryana and Himachal Pradesh can be checked against a primary source rather than secondary reporting.

The Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas should publicly state the outcome of its 8 April 2025 request to Punjab to roll back the ₹1/BL ethanol regulatory fee, so that blenders, distillers and other states know whether the Centre's objection has been accepted, withdrawn or is still pending.

The Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas should notify the compressed-biogas shortfall-volume charge as a statutory rule with a defined sanction, rather than leaving it in a February 2024 office memorandum, so that the CBG obligation has the same legal footing as the ₹2/litre unblended-fuel excise that applies to petrol and diesel.
